description: This PHP source file defines the class CandidateVacancyDecorator within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to associate candidates and vacancies by ID and to retrieve the status of a candidate vacancy, acting as a decorator for the CandidateVacancy entity.

classes.name: CandidateVacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CandidateVacancy entity providing methods to modify and retrieve candidate-vacancy relationship information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a CandidateVacancy object.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy object with the candidateVacancy by vacancy ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with the candidateVacancy by candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the candidate vacancy, returning an array with mapped ID and formatted label.
